ticket.summary: Only toilet in home is fully blocked (bowl fills near rim, plunger failed) after 6-year-old flushed something ~1hr ago; other drains flow fine, so localized trap clog/foreign object — booked first priority slot.
mitigation_advice: Stop flushing the toilet until the tech arrives
Close the toilet's supply shutoff valve (small oval handle on supply line, clockwise until snug) to prevent overflow [PB-01]

quote_lines.description: Toilet clog clearing (auger); possible foreign object (kids' toy) — tech to confirm any additional charge if toilet must be pulled

ticket.customer_message: You're all set — 5 Coppersmith Ave, Monday Sep 1 at 8:00 AM (slot SL-0901-0800), $149 flat for toilet clog clearing. With the valve closed the bowl can't refill, so you shouldn't get an overflow overnight. If anything changes — water starts coming up in the tub/shower or spills onto the floor — text back and we'll page the on-call plumber right away. Sleep easy, and thanks for choosing Brookdale Plumbing!
